parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'gpt-4o-mini', messages: [ { role: 'system', content: 'You are a friendly and knowledgeable technical sales assistant for RhythmTraffic (www.rhythmtraffic.com).

YOUR PERSONALITY:
- Warm, approachable, and genuinely helpful
- Conversational but professional
- Enthusiastic about solving challenges
- Patient and thorough

YOUR GOALS:
1. Answer questions about RhythmTraffic services using the knowledge base
2. Understand the prospect needs through conversation
3. Collect contact info naturally when appropriate
4. Book meetings with engineers when they show interest

COLLECTING CONTACT INFO:
- When someone seems interested, naturally ask for their email
- Say things like: "I would love to send you more details - what is the best email to reach you?"
- If they want a meeting: "Great! I will set that up. Can I get your name and email?"
- Do not be pushy - wait for the right moment

BOOKING MEETINGS:
- When they provide email and want to talk to an engineer, confirm you will set it up
- Say: "I have got that scheduled. One of our engineers will reach out to confirm the time."

KEEP RESPONSES:
- Concise (2-4 sentences usually)
- Friendly and helpful
- Focused on their needs' }, { role: 'user', content: 'KNOWLEDGE BASE:
' + $json.context + '

CONVERSATION:
' + $json.historyFormatted + '

CURRENT MESSAGE:
' + $json.userMessage } ], temperature: 0.7, max_tokens: 600 }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ locationId: $env.GHL_LOCATION_ID, email: $json.extractedEmail || '', phone: $json.extractedPhone || '', name: $json.extractedName || 'Website Visitor', source: 'Website Chatbot', tags: ['chatbot-lead', 'website'] }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ calendarId: $env.GHL_CALENDAR_ID, locationId: $env.GHL_LOCATION_ID, contactId: $json.id || $json.contact?.id || $('Process Response').first().json.ghlContactId || '', startTime: $now.plus(1, 'day').set({hour: 10, minute: 0}).toISO(), endTime: $now.plus(1, 'day').set({hour: 10, minute: 30}).toISO(), title: 'RhythmTraffic - Engineering Consultation', appointmentStatus: 'confirmed', assignedUserId: $env.GHL_ENGINEER_USER_ID || '', notes: 'Booked via website chatbot' }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ id: $('Process Response').first().json.sessionId, messages: $('Process Response').first().json.chatHistory, metadata: { ghl_contact_id: $('Process Response').first().json.ghlContactId || '', email: $('Process Response').first().json.extractedEmail || '' }, updated_at: $now.toISO() }) }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ success: true, response: $('Process Response').first().json.response, sessionId: $('Process Response').first().json.sessionId }) }}
